## Quickstart

Use the REST endpoint and token above with the Upstash SDK.

To re-fetch these credentials, POST again with the database id as the
`Idempotency-Key` header.

Avoid storing sensitive data (PII, secrets, production credentials) — this
database is temporary and not tied to a user account until claimed.
